title: Prism fact schema v0
description: T1-oriented fact shapes. Semantic (T3/T4) layers are separate artifacts — do not encode CPG here.
breaking_change_policy: Major version bump in schemas/ and prism-ir::FACT_SCHEMA_VERSION.
unresolved_policy: CALLS that cannot be same-file resolved use dst id unresolved:{name} with confidence heuristic; never silently drop.
id_policy: Prefer readable deterministic syntactic IDs (SCIP-compatible where possible). Avoid opaque integer-only IDs.

ir_layers.L0: Raw bytes / paths — P0 populates via fingerprint
